criteria.requirement: The explicit one_shot_view.list() first traversal consumes the source and a second cannot recover the header, raising FieldSelectionError. Builtin list(view) can already exhaust a one-shot source via the inherited __len__ before its actual traversal. Existing view.list() or list(iter(view)) avoids that outer length hint, but does not make the source replayable. Use a replayable source or an explicit size/storage-bounded snapshot; do not promise automatic caching or stable data against source changes.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
